name: YAMAN - Yet Another Motion Automation (N-th time)
description: Comprehensive motion-activated lighting automation with sun conditions, brightness settings, off-delay, and manual override options.

name: Awesome HA Blueprints - Light Hook
description: Connects controllers (switches, remotes) to light entities with full dimming, color temperature, and scene toggle capabilities.

name: Awesome HA Blueprints - Media Player Hook
description: Links button remotes and controllers directly to Home Assistant media players for playback, volume, and track control.

name: Awesome HA Blueprints - Cover Controller Hook
description: Hooks remotes and wall switches to motorized blinds, shades, and garage covers.

name: Notify when door/window left open
description: Sends a notification if an exterior door, window, or contact sensor remains open longer than a configured timeout.

name: Low Battery Level Notification & Audit
description: Audits all battery-powered entities and sends an alert when any battery percentage drops below a threshold.

name: Appliance Power Monitor & Notification
description: Monitors smart plug power draw to detect when washing machines, dryers, or dishwashers finish their cycle.

name: Motion and Illuminance Activated Light
description: Turns on a target light when motion is detected, restricted optionally by ambient illuminance (lux) levels or sun state.

name: Window Open HVAC Auto-Pause
description: Automatically turns off or pauses climate thermostats when contact sensors detect open windows or doors.

name: Presence & Motion Lighting Sync
description: Manages room lighting using presence sensors and motion sensors with customizable timeouts and illuminance thresholds.
